You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For-   The Baseline (Hard Skills):   Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills):   The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face   What You Will Get:   Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face:   100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

Job Description  Make the world your home.    It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.    What we offer    Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589) per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits: Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world The Role  As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.   Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction What you'll bring  To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:   A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDS  Additional Information    Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our " Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.    To learn more visit    Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Especialista de consolidação/consolidation specialist - oportunidade também para pcd♿
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista de consolidação/consolidation specialist - oportunidade também para pcd♿ em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:      The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.    The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.      KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:      Quarterly package review - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.   - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.   - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.   - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.   - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.      Group analyses - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.      One-off items - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.   - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M& A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.   - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.      OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.      REQUIREMENTS:    Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).    Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.    Languages: Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).      Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:      Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4 HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).    Soft Skills: Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.    Essential Qualities: Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.      In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Gestor de negócios ii | diagnóstico ivd
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Gestor de negócios ii | diagnóstico ivd em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

VIVEO - Cuidar de cada vida, simples assim!      Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.500 colaboradores diretos.      Com o propósito de cuidar de cada vida, somos a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.      Atividades:    Buscamos um profissional com perfil estratégico e comercial para atuar na gestão e desenvolvimento de uma carteira regional de laboratórios clínicos, com foco no mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD). Será responsável por fortalecer relacionamentos com contas estratégicas, identificar oportunidades de expansão, analisar mercado e concorrência, conduzir negociações e ampliar a participação da empresa nas contas existentes. A atuação será na região de Campinas e arredores, com rotina externa, visitas a clientes e interface com áreas internas para garantir execução, crescimento e geração de valor ao negócio.      Responsabilidades e atribuições:   • Administrar e desenvolver contas estratégicas, com atuação próxima aos clientes da carteira regional, buscando relacionamento de longo prazo e expansão de negócios;   • Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios por meio de mapeamento de mercado, levantamento de demandas, análise do potencial das contas e prospecção estruturada;   • Atuar de forma consultiva junto a laboratórios clínicos, compreendendo suas rotinas, necessidades operacionais e desafios, para propor soluções aderentes ao portfólio da empresa;   • Analisar concorrência, tendências e condições de mercado, gerando inteligência comercial para apoiar o posicionamento dos produtos e a tomada de decisão;   • Aumentar market share nas contas existentes, promovendo expansão de portfólio, fidelização de clientes e desenvolvimento de novas frentes comerciais;   • Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação por conta e por território, com foco em metas, rentabilidade, potencial de crescimento e cobertura de mercado;   • Construir relacionamento com decisores e influenciadores das contas, incluindo áreas técnicas, administrativas, suprimentos e liderança dos laboratórios;   • Conduzir negociações comerciais, acompanhando propostas, condições comerciais, prazos, follow-ups e fechamento de oportunidades;   • Acompanhar o ciclo de vendas de ponta a ponta, desde a prospecção e qualificação até implantação, pós-venda e monitoramento de resultados;   • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas como marketing, produto, aplicação, suporte e operações, assegurando alinhamento entre estratégia comercial e entrega ao cliente;   • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da carteira, pipeline, conversão, participação de mercado e evolução das contas;   • Cumprir agenda de visitas, rotas e demandas comerciais dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, com atuação externa frequente na região designada.      Requisitos:   • Graduação completa;   • Vivência no segmento de diagnóstico clínico IVD, preferencialmente com relacionamento junto a laboratórios clínicos;   • Experiência em gestão de contas, prospecção e desenvolvimento de negócios;   • Conhecimento em análise de mercado, concorrência e planejamento comercial;   • Habilidade para negociação, relacionamento com clientes e condução de vendas consultivas;   • Domínio do Pacote Office;   • CNH categoria B;   • Disponibilidade para viagens;   • Residir em Campinas ou arredores;      Diferenciais   • Experiência prévia com carteira de laboratórios clínicos;   • Conhecimento do mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e suas dinâmicas comerciais;   • Vivência com contas estratégicas e expansão regional de mercado;   • Familiaridade com CRM, gestão de funil e indicadores comerciais.

Localidade:   • Alemanha (Berlim, Munique ou outras cidades com demanda hospitalar — a definir conforme colocação)   Programa:   • Enfermanha - Enfermagem na Alemanha, da Sprache& Wissen.   Como funciona?   • Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), estuda alemão por até 2 anos até atingir o nível B2 (intermediário completo). Você escolhe onde estudar — na escola da Sprache& Wissen (maior online de alemão da América Latina) ou em outra instituição validada. Concluída a etapa de estudos, dentro dos requisitos do programa, a S& W te conecta com sua oportunidade profissional na Alemanha.   Quem é a Sprache& Wissen?   • A Sprache& Wissen (S& W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S& W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, vai capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%. Colocação profissional na Alemanha

title: Airbus a320 captain | uae relocation opportunity
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Airbus a320 captain | uae relocation opportunity em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description  Make the world your home.    It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.    Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.    What we offer    Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589) per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits: Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world The Role  As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.   Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction What you'll bring  To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:   A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDS  Additional Information    Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our " Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.    To learn more visit    Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDS  Additional Information    Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our " Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.    To learn more visit    Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Electrical engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Electrical engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

You have built solid experience in high-voltage engineering and you are ready to take full technical ownership of primary system design on projects that sit at the heart of the energy transition. If working on complex HV infrastructure for a technically leading organisation in Europe interests you, this role is worth your full attention.      Company Information    Our client is a recognised leader in the design, implementation, and management of high-voltage systems in the Netherlands. With a strong focus on innovation and sustainable energy strategy, they work at the forefront of grid enhancement and energy transition projects across the sector. Their engineering teams bring deep technical expertise to primary HV systems and the civil and structural solutions required to support them. This is a technically driven organisation where quality, precision, and engineering integrity are central to everything they deliver.      Vacancy Information    As an Electrical Engineer, your focus sits firmly in the domain of high-voltage primary systems and the supporting structures required for the installation and mounting of HV components. This includes power transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, current and voltage instrument transformers, cable and overhead line connections, and all associated civil and structural support arrangements.    You will take full responsibility from basic design through detailed design and on to execution and project delivery. You will translate functional requirements into concrete technical solutions, prepare and review engineering documentation, and support the Lead Engineer and Technical Manager across all project phases. When design bottlenecks arise, you identify and resolve them. When quality checks are needed, you perform them.    This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership and direct involvement from the earliest design stages through to final delivery.      Key Responsibilities Translating functional designs and client requirements into concrete technical designs and project plans for HV primary systems. Designing and verifying integrated solutions based on client specifications, applicable technical standards including IEC and ABNT, and relevant laws and regulations. Preparing and reviewing technical documentation, engineering drawings, calculations, and execution documents across all project phases. Supporting the Lead Engineer and Technical Manager from basic design in the preparation phase through to detailed execution design. Identifying and resolving design bottlenecks, reporting findings to the wider project team, and performing quality checks on deliverables. Working closely with civil, structural, and electrical disciplines to ensure that primary component installations are fully integrated and constructible.    What You Need Bachelor degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Power Engineering, or a comparable technical field. Solid experience in high-voltage primary system design, with working knowledge of HV components such as power transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, and instrument transformers including CTs and VTs. Familiarity with HV substation layouts, overhead line connections, cable termination arrangements, and supporting civil and structural requirements. Understanding of applicable technical standards and design codes relevant to high-voltage systems including IEC standards. Familiarity with ABNT NBR requirements is considered an advantage. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to develop and verify integrated technical solutions under project conditions. REQUISITOS ESSENCIAIS     • Experiência comprovada em venda consultiva B2 B dentro do mercado de marketing digital, agência ou serviços de marketing. Requisito eliminatório, não diferencial. Procuramos quem já vendeu esse tipo de serviço e conhece o setor por dentro.   • Maturidade e repertório para conduzir uma reunião de fechamento com autonomia, enquadrar a necessidade do cliente e sustentar valor sem recorrer a preço.   • Capacidade de operar o ciclo completo de vendas com autonomia e total responsabilidade sobre o próprio funil.   • Domínio de negociação, diagnóstico e fechamento consultivo de contratos com recorrência mensal.   • Disciplina de pipeline e familiaridade com CRM (Hub Spot, Kommo, RD Station, Pipedrive ou similar) e metodologias de funil (SPIN, BANT, GPCT).   • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara, com argumentação ancorada em dados e em valor.      Não buscamos vendedor de varejo nem consultor de vendas sem vivência no mercado de marketing. Também não é a posição certa para quem só rende com oportunidades entregues prontas por uma estrutura de pré-venda. Aqui você conduz o ciclo do início ao fim.      DESEJÁ VEL     • Vivência com venda de serviços de marketing digital, growth ou branding com ticket recorrente.   • Conhecimento de métricas de performance (CAC, ROAS, CPA, LTV, margem) no nível de leitura executiva.   • Repertório no ciclo consultivo completo: qualificação, diagnóstico, proposta, fechamento e passagem para o onboarding.   • Boa compreensão de como marcas crescem a partir de dados, estratégia e execução integrada.      NOSSO TIME VAI GOSTAR SE VOCÊ…     • Entende que crescimento sustentável depende de qualidade de cliente, não de volume.   • Gosta de trabalhar com método e previsibilidade, medindo resultado e buscando evolução constante.   • É curioso e propositivo, não se limita a seguir script: questiona, sugere, melhora o processo.   • Se comunica com clareza, organiza o próprio pipeline e entrega o que promete.   • Enxerga o marketing como um sistema integrado de crescimento, e valoriza o equilíbrio entre performance e marca.      O QUE OFERECEMOS     • Estrutura sólida, com metodologia própria de crescimento e visão de longo prazo.   • Atuação com marcas relevantes de diferentes setores (educação, finanças, saúde, varejo, indústria).   • Cultura de autonomia, aprendizado e melhoria contínua.   • Distribuição de lucro uma vez por ano.   • Day-off no seu aniversário.   • Modelo híbrido, com base em Brasília.   • Contratação PJ, com fixo mais variável recorrente sobre os contratos fechados. Analista de Produtos SAP Sênior      A Systax é uma empresa especializada em soluções tecnológicas para a área tributária. Ela oferece serviços que visam automatizar e otimizar a gestão fiscal das empresas, ajudando-as a lidar com a complexidade do sistema tributário brasileiro.      A Systax é conhecida por sua base de dados tributária, que é uma das mais completas do país, com +29 milhões de regras tributárias, abrangendo os 27 estados da federação. Além disso, fornece ferramentas que auxiliam na correta aplicação da legislação fiscal, minimizando riscos e aumentando a eficiência operacional. A empresa frequentemente realiza eventos e palestras para discutir atualizações e tendências na área, especialmente no momento com a Reforma tributária. Comunicação clara e objetiva: Nos comunicamos de forma clara, prática e concisa, com uma mentalidade global e uma postura incansavelmente construtiva. Propósito e aprendizado contínuo: Trabalhamos com propósito e utilizamos ferramentas tecnológicas para promover agilidade no aprendizado e na evolução constante. Agilidade e colaboração: Agimos com senso de urgência e compartilhamos continuamente o que aprendemos, com foco em interações frequentes, velocidade e resiliência. Tomada de decisão orientada por tecnologia: Conduzimos decisões e influenciamos resultados por meio da tecnologia, adaptando-nos rapidamente quando novas informações surgem. Foco em resultados e valor ao cliente: Somos donos dos resultados, apoiamos a inovação de forma objetiva, documentamos decisões e avaliamos nosso trabalho sempre com foco na entrega de valor ao cliente.    DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA      Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Produtos SAP Sênior que atuará no desenvolvimento, evolução e sustentação de soluções fiscais integradas ao SAP S/4 HANA, com foco em Tax Service. A posição exige conhecimento técnico-funcional em cenários fiscais SAP, com capacidade de apoiar projetos, analisar requisitos de negócio, orientar times internos e contribuir para a estabilidade e evolução do produto, com ênfase em determinação de impostos, integração com motor de cálculo externo e legislação tributária brasileira. REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS/OBRIGATÓRIOS:     Experiência sólida om SAP, preferencialmente em cenários fiscais e de integração; Conhecimento avançado em determinação de impostos no SAP, incluindo tax procedure e condition technique; Experiência prática nos módulos SD e MM, com entendimento desejável de impactos e interfaces em FI; Bons conhecimentos da legislação tributária brasileira, contemplando ICMS, ICMS ST, IPI, PIS/COFINS, ISS, IBS e CBS; Experiência com NF-e e demais documentos fiscais eletrônicos; Atuação em análise de erros e troubleshooting; Conhecimento em integrações por APIs, RFCs e middleware, como SAP CPI/PI, com capacidade de interlocução entre times funcionais e técnicos; Inglês avançado ou fluente.    FORMAÇÃO NECESSÁRIA:      Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas , compatível com atuação técnico-funcional em SAP e processos fiscais.      REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS – DIFERENCIAL:     Experiência com SAP S/4 HANA – Tax Service; Vivência em integração com motores fiscais (Tax Service); Vivência em projetos de implementação, além de suporte; Conhecimento em debug ABAP em nível funcional/técnico.    Benefícios     Convênio médico Sul América (coparticipação). Convênio odontológico Sul América. Seguro-viagem nacional e internacional. Vale refeição (Flex). Auxílio creche. Auxílio filho com deficiência. Seguro de Vida. Wellhub (Gympass). Linked In Learning (Acesso a mais de 21 mil cursos, em diversas áreas). CEFIS - Plataforma de Conhecimento (Acesso a mais de 500 cursos de capacitação e atualização profissional). Parceria de desconto em cursos/treinamentos de SAP. Parceria de desconto em cursos de inglês. Outras facilidades e parcerias de descontos. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.  Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:  Communication:  Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking:  Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making:  Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.  Benefits & Compensation  Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.
